sections.heading: Contents
East Point Medical College overview

content.text: East Point Medical College Bangalore is a part of the jnana Prabha campus and houses an educational institution. It was established by DR S M Venkatapathi. It was established in 2017. College is affiliated to RAJIV GANDHI UNIVERSITY OF HEALTH SCIENCEs. Mission of the college is to bring the quality health care including underprivileged people and so give the best educational quality and stress free period for the students

sections.heading: Key Highlights

content.text: East Point Medical College Bangalore is affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Science ,Bangalore .and was approved by medical council of India. It was established in 1996 by government of Karnataka and nearly 3000 colleges affiliated. The college is under Jnana Prabha campus educational institution .the other colleges that comes under are

items: East point college of engineering and technology.
East point college of management.
East point college of nursing.
East point college of pharmacy.
East point PU college and schools.

content.text: East Point college has its own partner hospital on the campus of the college . students get to learn and treat patients after a certain time in the guidance of seniors and faculty staff .East Point campus is quite a large campus with hospital ,college , hostel and playgrounds .College is in the outskirts of Bangalore away from the traffic noise. College is around so many villages which brings in a lot of casualties to the hospital.

sections.heading: Why study at East Point medical college?

content.text: College is in the outskirts of the city area but it is a blessing for medical students for good study and focus. Although college is recently established but college has such good results and good reviews in a short period of time.

items: Course structure – All the courses in the college run by appropriate curriculum given by the university to the college. College curriculum is designed in a such way that student can learn both practicals and teaching faculty are professional and modern learning equipment

Infrastructure – College has a large campus with lush greenery and large playgrounds for walks . College ,hospital ,mess and hostel situated in the same campus makes student life a lot easier and saves students a lot of money and time.

Hospital – Where a lot of other colleges have tried with other hospitals for students to learn, East point medical college has its own hospital .Hospital has so many beds where you can practice medicine everyday under the guidance of staff. Well this is the reason you should consider joining the east point college. The hospital brings a lot of patients and the better the patient flow the better the learning.

College ethics and committees – College has set a few facility members in the committees to look after a few issues like ragging, eg – anti -ragging committee will take strict actions and preventive measures to avoid ragging. Student counselor will look into issue student faces in the college and work on solution. This college really stands on their mission.

sections.heading: Courses Offered
MBBS

content.text: East Point Medical College Bangalore offers only one course in this campus i.e., MBBS. The college has other campuses for other courses like nursing ,business and many others mentioned above. MBBS is a undergraduate degree. one can join MBBS after 12th and one can proceed MD after MBBS
MBBS is total 5 and half year course that is – Four and half years

items: First year – 1 year long.
Second year – 1 and half year.
Third year – 1 year.
Fourth year – 1 year and,

content.text: One year internship – Internship program is also a compulsory part of MBBS . It is a period in MBBS where you work as a doctor in the hospital . interns in the hospitals are more exposed to the patient and work in hospitals with minimum salary. Internships can be done in the hospital of your choice .eg – in case you don’t want to continue in east point medical college you can ask for transfer in the college of your choice .

sections.heading: MBBS Subjects

items: First year (1 YEAR)
Second year (one and half years)
Third year ( 1 year )
Fourth year

sections.heading: Departments

items: Anatomy

content.text: The Anatomy department of the college has various collections of species and human body parts like ( brain ,lungs ,tongue ,face etc.) for study purposes . In fact , this is the first thing you do after joining college in the first year . department also has skulls and bones of the body ,charts and models for better learning . department also have microscopes and histology slides.

items: Physiology

content.text: Physiology is one of the first three practical in MBBS(first year)and physiology is a branch of biology that deals with normal functions of the human body and life, basic things that you will need for life will thought in this lab like measurement of blood pressure ,pulse rate, hematology test. lab of physiology in east point medical college is well equipped and four practical halls just for physiology with modern microscopes and equipment for practical.

items: Biochemistry

content.text: Biochemistry is a science that deals with chemical and physio-chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms. teachers in biochemistry lab will teach you about chemicals and experiments like differential tests for blood sugars ,chemical examination of normal urine, test for jaundice( liver function test). Lab in east point medical college is huge and has a single hall which can accommodate 100 students. Lab is facilitated with all the equipment and audio – visual smart screens.

items: Pathology

content.text: Pathology is a branch of science that deals with study of disease and diagnosis through removed tissue. lab in east point medical college of pathology is equipped with modern diagnostic aids for investigations and hematology instruments. department has a museum that has a collection of various number of spices of diseased organs and chart and models for better understanding. Pathology lab also has around 100 microscopes for studying slides.

items: Microbiology

content.text: Microbiology is a branch of science that deals with study of microorganisms and morphology of the microorganisms. lab has one single hall that can accommodate 75 students staining.

items: Pharmacology

content.text: Pharmacology is a branch of medical science that deals with the study of drugs and its mechanism. Pharmacology is one of the interesting practicals of MBBS. Lab is totally equipped for drug preparation. Equipment used in college are verified and safe.

items: Forensic Medicine

content.text: The department teaches the legal aspect of medical practice to students that helps in resolution of criminal cases on the basis of scientific facts. The department has access to laboratories and seminar rooms. For forensic study the lab is facilitated with microscope ,x-ray machines. Age estimation is learnt by x -rays and the main aspect that help in study of the criminal case is dentition of the criminal ,bite marks and lip bite. tooth molds and OPG are given for studies. Department also has a museum that has a collection of various bones, forensic cases and photographs, snake specimens and different types of weapons.

items: Community Medicine

content.text: Community medicine department is all about serving the rural population by offering them medical service. The department of east point medical college conducts at least two camps every week .The department is equipped with smart TVs for displaying content in the form of videos and pictures for better understanding of students and patients. Department also has computers for statistical cells, community medicine has a number of charts ,posters and survey cases for better understanding about health issues and hygiene importance and educating patients for the same.

sections.heading: Teaching-Learning Methods

content.text: College provides a time table in the beginning of the academic year. Time table is decided by the staff and committee. Various tools are used for better teaching like smart classes, videos and pictures, PPT, various charts and models. Things that makes learning easy are

items: Weekly test.
Teaching plus notes.
Use of digital tools to learn.
Mentorship – college make few teacher mentor and students can approach their mentor for any problems and doubts.

sections.heading: Workshop Programs

content.text: College conducts number of workshops and learning programs throughout a year for students and staff. workshops like,

items: Workshop on lesson planning.
Workshop on mentorship.
Workshop on blood donation.
Workshop on AIDS.

Admission process

content.text: If you are interested in admission into East Point medical college Bangalore, there are certain steps and procedures, and they include:

sections.heading: Step 1: Appear for the Entrance Exam

content.text: NEET UG is the necessary admission requirement for the MBBS program. Students interested in seeking admission into East Point medical college, must qualify for the undergraduate entrance exam.

sections.heading: Step 2: Register for State NEET Counselling

content.text: All those who qualified from the entrance exams can now register for the Karnataka NEET UG counselling. The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) conducts the state counselling. You can visit Karnataka MBBS admission for further information.

sections.heading: Step 3: Seat Allotment

content.text: Once the seat allotment list is published, selected applicants should report to the respective college.

sections.heading: Step 4: Document Verification

content.text: Candidates have to proceed toward verifying their respective documents.

sections.heading: Step 5: Required Fee Payment

content.text: Selected students ought to make the required fee payment to confirm admission.

sections.heading: Entrance examination

content.text: East Point Medical College Bangalore doesn’t conduct their own entrance examination for the admissions , although there few state and national entrance examination one has to pass or qualify for admission examination like NEET ( national eligibility cum entrance test).

sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria

items: Candidates must have passed 12th standard / PUC from board or council.
Candidates should have passed 12th standard in PCMB subjects (physics, chemistry ,mathematics and biology).
Candidates must have qualify NEET entrance examination with at least 50 percent marks.
Must have completed seventeen years of age as on 31st December as on the year of admission.
Candidates must have all required documents mentioned below.

sections.heading: East Point Medical College Fees

content.text: If you want more information on the fee structure of other Karnataka medical colleges, check out our article on MBBS Fee Structure in Karnataka .
The East Point Medical College Bangalore fees for all the quotas is given in the tables for undergraduate and postgraduate courses-

sections.heading: MBBS Fees
MD/MS Fees

items: Scholarships – college helps the student with scholarships every year for those who have top scored in an academic year and NSS also provide scholarships for some category every year.

Educational loans – The institution arranges for the loan from various nationalized and private banks, you can avail this facility by and talking to bank manager and administrative office at college. Educational loans needs support of parents and signature and college has to provide a letter and fee structure to the respective bank and you will have to submit your passing marks card of previous year for loan every year.

Placements – East Point Medical College does not promise you placements after completion of MBBS for that matter no MBBS college promises or help you for placements but college helps for internship. Internship is the most important period of MBBS life in this period. East Point medical college has its own hospital for internship.

sections.heading: East Point Hospital & Services

content.text: Hospital is located on the campus of East Point Medical College Bangalore. since this college belongs to the college . staff of the college are doctors in the hospital and interns work under the staff .staff and interns (residents) help the students. The hospital has all the facilities for students and patients.

sections.heading: Emergency service

content.text: Emergency department works 24×7 with OPD which is also attached to 10 labor beds and 10 emergency beds equipped with oxygen supply , oximeter, crash carts ,monitors and minor operation theaters

sections.heading: OPD (outpatient department)

content.text: All departments like general medicine ,general surgery, ENT, derma, ophthalmology ,dental, psychiatry have their own OPD service and there is also general OPD from where patient are sent to respective departments and there are 24 beds distribution among these departments

sections.heading: Diagnostic facilities

content.text: All the diagnostic services are available at a single laboratory.it has all three departments attached to it microbiology, pathology and biochemistry. Laboratory is totally modernized and provides accurate results in short period and open 24 x7

sections.heading: Radiology

content.text: Department of radiology has 2 portable x ray machines frequency ranging from 300mA,600mA, and 800mA.Also has ultrasound machines and CT Scan

sections.heading: ICU (intensive care unit)

content.text: ICU has total 35 beds in number and also works 24 x 7 with physicians and intensivists, bedside nurses and anesthesiologists is particularized and specified with all equipment, especially ventilators.

Other departments – The college has all the departments like blood bank ,pharmacy, operation theaters, gynecology, ambulance service, department of dentistry. Departments are fully facilitated and punctual providing great service to patients and humanity.

sections.heading: On-Campus Facilities Offered

content.text: ➤ campus – East Point Medical college has vast campus area.it is located in the outskirts of city ,surrounded by green and campus is spacious, parking facilities are available in campus only, environment is very pleasant especially studying which keep students fresh.

➤ classrooms – The college has 4 theaters with light and ventilation. Classrooms have centralized air conditioners ,smart class, white and green board, metallic chairs and table. There are separate demo classes in every department with basic white boards and chairs.

➤ laboratories – The college has separate labs for separate departments which are also very ventilated and hygienic. All the safety measures have been taken in construction and maintenance .There are well equipped and students are provided with all the materials for experiments and practical.
➤ Auditoriums – Very spacious , can accommodate more than 400 people , college conducts various events here such as graduation ,intra and inter college fest ,freshers and small celebrations.

➤ Cafeteria and Canteen – The college has a cafeteria which is small that serves hot and cold beverages for a reasonable price .It also has snacks like maggie, samosa ,chips and ice creams.c anteen serves meals and breakfast which is fixed price and fixed menu.

➤ Playground – The college has not too big but it is quite a playground on campus. you can play a sport of your choice in the playground. Volleyball, throwball, football nets are available. people enjoy playing cricket here mostly. sports events are conducted in the playground every year.

➤ Hostels – The college has two separate hostels for boys and girls. Both hostels can accommodate about 200-300 students. Hostel has two sharing ,three sharing rooms according to convenience .Hostel has all basic facilities like hot water ,table and chairs ,hygiene washrooms, laundry services ,separate dining area ,separate tv room ,wi-fi and internet service.
➤ Community health camps – Health camps are conducted twice a week from college. where residents visit satellite areas and treat patients also educate patients of rural areas.
➤ Events in college – The college encourage and conduct so many events every year ,fest are conducted every year to encourage student talent and sports.

➤ Library – college library is well organized ,spacious and ventilated .It has a collection of all the authors books of national and international authors. Books are sufficient in number. library has 3 divisions one is study hall , one is not air conditioned area and the other air conditioned area .Library operates from morning 8am to 10pm . It also have a collection of journals ,magazines ,question papers and news papers.
➤ Digital library – college has a digital library attached to central library. Digital library has computers and fast internet they also have CDs, and xerox machine for print.

MBBS Fees

MD/MS Fees

Scholarships – college helps the student with scholarships every year for those who have top scored in an academic year and NSS also provide scholarships for some category every year.

Educational loans – The institution arranges for the loan from various nationalized and private banks, you can avail this facility by and talking to bank manager and administrative office at college. Educational loans needs support of parents and signature and college has to provide a letter and fee structure to the respective bank and you will have to submit your passing marks card of previous year for loan every year.

Placements – East Point Medical College does not promise you placements after completion of MBBS for that matter no MBBS college promises or help you for placements but college helps for internship. Internship is the most important period of MBBS life in this period. East Point medical college has its own hospital for internship.

East Point Hospital & Services

Hospital is located on the campus of East Point Medical College Bangalore. since this college belongs to the college . staff of the college are doctors in the hospital and interns work under the staff .staff and interns (residents) help the students. The hospital has all the facilities for students and patients.

Emergency service

Emergency department works 24×7 with OPD which is also attached to 10 labor beds and 10 emergency beds equipped with oxygen supply , oximeter, crash carts ,monitors and minor operation theaters

OPD (outpatient department)

All departments like general medicine ,general surgery, ENT, derma, ophthalmology ,dental, psychiatry have their own OPD service and there is also general OPD from where patient are sent to respective departments and there are 24 beds distribution among these departments

Diagnostic facilities

All the diagnostic services are available at a single laboratory.it has all three departments attached to it microbiology, pathology and biochemistry. Laboratory is totally modernized and provides accurate results in short period and open 24 x7

Radiology

Department of radiology has 2 portable x ray machines frequency ranging from 300mA,600mA, and 800mA.Also has ultrasound machines and CT Scan

ICU (intensive care unit)

ICU has total 35 beds in number and also works 24 x 7 with physicians and intensivists, bedside nurses and anesthesiologists is particularized and specified with all equipment, especially ventilators.

Other departments – The college has all the departments like blood bank ,pharmacy, operation theaters, gynecology, ambulance service, department of dentistry. Departments are fully facilitated and punctual providing great service to patients and humanity.

➤ campus – East Point Medical college has vast campus area.it is located in the outskirts of city ,surrounded by green and campus is spacious, parking facilities are available in campus only, environment is very pleasant especially studying which keep students fresh.

➤ laboratories – The college has separate labs for separate departments which are also very ventilated and hygienic. All the safety measures have been taken in construction and maintenance .There are well equipped and students are provided with all the materials for experiments and practical.

➤ Auditoriums – Very spacious , can accommodate more than 400 people , college conducts various events here such as graduation ,intra and inter college fest ,freshers and small celebrations.

➤ Community health camps – Health camps are conducted twice a week from college. where residents visit satellite areas and treat patients also educate patients of rural areas.

➤ Events in college – The college encourage and conduct so many events every year ,fest are conducted every year to encourage student talent and sports.

Books are sufficient in number. library has 3 divisions one is study hall , one is not air conditioned area and the other air conditioned area .Library operates from morning 8am to 10pm . It also have a collection of journals ,magazines ,question papers and news papers.

➤ Digital library – college has a digital library attached to central library. Digital library has computers and fast internet they also have CDs, and xerox machine for print.

sections.heading: Karnataka MBBS Admission for Other State Students 2026

content.text: Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

Karnataka MBBS admission for other state student is possible only if the candidate qualifies NEET-UG 2024, secures the minimum required marks and attends all levels of KEA counselling if interested in joining private medical colleges in Karnataka. Alternatively, if interested in joining deemed medical colleges in karnataka, they should attend MCC counselling.
2. KEA’s Role in Karnataka MBBS admission for other states:

The Karnataka Examination Authority (KEA) oversees private medical colleges’ MBBS admissions in Karnataka. KEA handles all procedures, including online registration, document verification, online counselling, seat allotment, and issuance of admission orders, in accordance with government rules. Eligibility for participating in counselling is contingent upon qualifying in NEET UG 2024, as KEA will conduct the process based on your NEET scores.
3. MCC’s Role in Deemed Medical Colleges admission:

If you are interested in joining deemed medical colleges in Karnataka, you should attend the counselling conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC). The central counselling for NEET is conducted by the MCC for admission to the 15 percent All India Quota (AIQ) seats.
4. Karnataka MBBS admission for other states students in Government Medical Colleges:

Non-Karnataka students can apply for seats in government medical colleges in Karnataka through the All India Quota (AIQ), which reserves 15% of the total seats for students from all over India. These seats are filled based on the NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) scores.

For non-Karnataka students seeking admission to government medical colleges in Karnataka, the admissions are managed through the All India Quota (AIQ) counseling process. This process is conducted by the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) under the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India.

sections.heading: What is career mudhra?

content.text: We are a leading Indian Career Counseling Portal offering Expert Personalised Career Counseling, Admission Guidance, College Listings, Entrance exam updates, & fee information. We aim to help students make informed decisions about their academic and career paths.

sections.heading: Our Story

content.text: Tracing Success : CareerMudhra’s Mission to Guide a Generation

In the lively city of Bangalore, a story of vision and perseverance began to unfold in 2005. Dr. Sushil Agarwal, a doctor and entrepreneur, arrived with a dream to revolutionize educational guidance in India.
Two years earlier, he had embarked on a mission to help BDS aspirants secure admissions to top Indian colleges. Now, he was ready to take his vision to the next level.

With determination in his heart, Dr. Agarwal laid the foundation of Careermudhra.  For over a decade, Dr. Agarwal and his team worked tirelessly, guiding students and helping them navigate the complex world of higher education.
They placed hundreds of students in prestigious institutions across India, not just securing admissions but also helping them choose the right courses and careers.
As the years passed, the world around them changed rapidly. The internet was becoming an integral part of everyday life.

In 2018, the team at Careermudhra realized the immense potential of the digital world in reaching out to students, providing information, and improving communication. This realization led to the birth of careermudhra.com.  In the same year, Dr. Pratiksha joined the company as a Quality and Research Specialist, focusing on dental education. The following year, Dr. Aditya came on board in a similar position, further strengthening the team’s expertise in dental programs.

The launch of the website marked a new chapter in their journey. The team worked day and night, curating information about thousands of colleges and courses, writing insightful blogs, and creating a user-friendly platform.
Their hard work paid off. Within a few years, careermudhra.com emerged as one of the top education-related websites in India.
It became a virtual guide for confused students, a light of hope for those uncertain about their future. The website’s popularity soared, attracting over 100,000 monthly visitors.
But numbers were never the goal for Dr. Agarwal and his team. Their true satisfaction came from the stories of success – the countless students who found their path through Careermudhra’s guidance.

In 2024, Ayan Ghosh, a seasoned career counselor, joined the company as a Senior NEET guidance expert in medical field career guidance. His appointment enhanced the organization’s expertise and expanded its services in healthcare-related professions.
Many students have been helped, each with a unique story of transformation and achievement.

Today, as CareerMudhra celebrates its 19th year, it stands tall as a testament to Dr. Agarwal’s vision. From a small office in Bangalore to a digital platform reaching students across India, the journey has been nothing short of extraordinary.

For those standing at the crossroads of their career, confused and seeking direction, CareerMudhra continues to be a guiding light. It’s not just a website; it’s a community, a support system, and a launchpad for dreams.

The story of CareerMudhra is far from over. With each passing day, they continue to evolve, innovate, and touch more lives. In the vast ocean of career choices, Careermudhra remains a steady ship, ready to help students navigate toward their bright futures.

article_name: Dayananda Sagar College Of Allied Health Sciences Fees 2025
author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: Dear students, Dayananda Sagar College of Allied Health Sciences in Dayananda Sagar University is one of the most reputed Allied Health Sciences deemed universities in Karnataka. DSU offers various courses including Allied health sciences, which is in high demand. In medical field, there is always need for trained paramedical professionals especially in areas like cardiac care, anesthesia, respiratory therapy, radiology, and medical laboratory technology. To get quality education with experienced faculties, advanced lab equipment, hands on experience and internships in hospitals with placements, Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences is the best choice. In this article, you will get to know about Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences courses and Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences fees structure in detail.
Looking for more colleges? Check our article about BSc cardiac care technology colleges in Karnataka to get all the detailed information.

sections.heading: Contents
Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences courses and seat matrix

content.text: The allied health sciences is a four year graduate program including one year internship training. Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences provides various kind of courses. The list given below is the courses and seat intake for Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences for the year 2025-2026
Fill out the form and click on “APPLY NOW” and we’ll reach out to you
GET PERSONALISED CAREER COUNSELLING WITH CAREERMUDHRA

sections.heading: Dayananda sagar college of allied health sciences Fees 2025

content.text: Dayananda Sagar college of allied health sciences provides quality education with internship in the affordable fees. The fees structure for allied health sciences for the year 2025 is given below:

items: B.Sc. Operation Theatre Technology : The fee is ₹1,42,000 per year, totaling ₹4,26,000 for three years.
B.Sc. Cardiac Care Technology : The annual fee is ₹1,42,000, making the total fee ₹4,26,000 for the entire course.
B.Sc. Radiology & Imaging Technology : This course costs ₹1,42,000 per year, amounting to ₹4,26,000 in total.
B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology : The fee per year is ₹1,42,000, and the total for three years is ₹4,26,000.
B.Sc. Renal Dialysis Technology : Students need to pay ₹1,42,000 annually, which adds up to ₹4,26,000 across three years.
B.Sc. Optometry : The yearly fee is ₹1,42,000, and the complete course fee is ₹4,26,000.
B.Sc. Anaesthesia Technology : The fee structure is ₹1,42,000 per year, totaling ₹4,26,000 for three years.
B.Sc. Emergency & Trauma Care Technology : The course fee is ₹1,42,000 per annum, with a total of ₹4,26,000 for the full duration.

content.text: Looking for admission process and eligibility criteria? Check our article about Allied health sciences at Dayananda sagar university to get all the details.

sections.heading: Conclusion

author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: Dear students, if you are looking to start your career in the field of healthcare other than MBBS, then allied health sciences is the perfect choice for you. There are different specializations of courses in Allied health sciences. These Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka cover a wide range of disciplines that help bridge the gap between diagnosis, therapy, and patient support. Allied health sciences refers to a wide group of healthcare professions that are distinct from medicine and nursing, and yet crucial to patient care and recovery. From diagnosis to therapy, from medical imaging to cardiac care technology, allied health professionals support smooth functioning of healthcare systems.

In Karnataka, a fast growing advancing state in terms of medical infrastructure and academic innovation, there are a number of reputed institutions offering BSc Allied health sciences. These courses are modified to prepare the students for employment in hospitals, diagnostic labs, and clinical places. With a strong importance for hands-on training, internships and clinical relevance, Karnataka is emerging as a top destination for students who wish to start a prominent career in allied health care. In this guide, we will explore all the Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, their top colleges, admission process and fee structure in detail.

sections.heading: Contents
Why Choose Karnataka for Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Karnataka is a leading center for medical and allied health sciences education in India. Karnataka’s capital Bangalore is known for its quality education and world class medical institutions and hospitals, making it a preferred choice for students to study. Other than Bangalore, cities like Mangalore, Mysore, Tumkur also have developed educational hubs and universities offering different allied health sciences courses.

In India, Karnataka is known for its modern and advanced infrastructure, quality education, modern labs and student environment. In Karnataka, a major number of institutions affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) provides high quality education. Other than RGUHS, there are some deemed universities also there with multi speciality hospital tie-ups. Karnataka is known for its research programs, innovation and employment. Students also get opportunities to work in international healthcare.

Due to the presence of more than 150 colleges offering Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, students have access to quality education, infrastructure, and placement opportunities across major cities.

sections.heading: Overview of Allied health sciences courses

content.text: Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are becoming increasingly popular due to rising demand in healthcare services and growing opportunities in both government and private sectors. Allied health sciences courses are designed to make a skilled professional to work efficiently in a healthcare environment. These programs cover diagnosis, technical, therapy and support services in healthcare. BSc Allied health sciences courses have a duration of three years of academic learning followed by a compulsory internship of six months to one year based on the course and university.

To study BSc Allied health in Karnataka, students must complete 10+2 with Physics, chemistry and biology as mandatory subjects. A minimum percentage of 45% to 50% marks is required. Some institutions may also conduct their own entrance exams or interviews for selection. Students will learn both theoretical and practical classes. Classes are conducted with advanced lab facilities even before they start their internships. These courses are recognized by Paramedical Board of Karnataka and most of the colleges are affiliated to RGUHS. After completion of allied health sciences, students are awarded a bachelor degree that qualify them to work as allied health professionals.

sections.heading: Courses in Allied Health Sciences

content.text: In Karnataka, there are different specializations in Allied health sciences where students can explore and choose on their respective interests.

sections.heading: BSc Cardiac Care Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Bsc cardiac care technology is one of the most in-demand Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka due to its high placement rate and scope in critical care. Because of its future career opportunities, students are interested in pursuing cardiac care technology. It focuses on cardiovascular medicine. These programs include subjects which are mainly focuses on echocardiography, electrocardiography, cardiac anatomy and catheterization techniques. After three years course and internship students will be able to work in ICU, assisting cardiac surgery and emergency wards.
Also Check: BSc cardiac care Technology in Bangalore BSc cardiac care Technology in Mangalore BSc cardiac care Technology in Mysore

sections.heading: BSc Operation Theatre Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: BSc in Operation Theatre Technology is among the key Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, ideal for students who want to work in real-time surgical settings. Students are trained to assist the surgeons during the time of operations by maintaining OT hygiene handling sterilizing equipment, surgical instruments and operation procedures. Students are also learn about infection control, anesthetics and monitor the patients. After the successful completion of course, students will work in specialty clinics, surgical units and trauma centers.

sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and critical care – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Anesthesia and Critical Care is a vital Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka that prepares students for emergency and ICU environments. This course is focusing on the administration and monitoring of anesthesia during the surgery and intensive care treatments. In this course students will learn about anesthetic agents, ventilator management and patient assessment. This course is more relatable in today’s medical environment, critical care is becoming an essential part of the treatment protocols. After completing the course, students will be able to work in emergency wards, ICU, trauma care and assist with anesthesiologists in operation theatres.

sections.heading: BSc Respiratory Therapy – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Respiratory Therapy is one of the rapidly growing Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. This courses is focusing on teaching the students about respiratory conditions like COPD, Asthma and more respiratory health issues. Respiratory courses helps students to learn about giving chest physiotherapy, managing artificial airways and handling ventilator. As respiratory conditions such as asthma, COPD, and post-COVID complications increase, the need for trained respiratory therapists is also growing. Respiratory therapy is used in ICU and emergency wards. This course also led the students to learn how to assist and manage oxygen therapy for patients with respiratory insufficiencies.

sections.heading: BSc Medical Imaging Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Medical Imaging is a highly in-demand Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka for students interested in diagnostic radiology. Medical Imaging Technology is focusing on teaching the use of diagnostic imaging equipment like CT scans, X rays, MRI, ultrasound machines. Students are taught to how to use these machines, positioning the patients in machines correctly, interpret results in collaboration with radiologists. The course curriculum also includes image processing techniques, radiation safety tips and anatomy. After completing the course, students will be able to work in diagnostic labs, radiology departments, even they pursue specialized training in radiodiagnosis or nuclear medicine.

sections.heading: BSc Medical Laboratory Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Medical Laboratory Technology is one of the core Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, essential for clinical diagnostics and pathology labs. This trains the students to do laboratory tests on biological specimens such as blood and tissues. It is a important step of disease diagnosis and monitoring. Students will learn microbiology, clinical pathology, hematology and biochemistry. After the successful completion of course, students will be work on diagnostic labs, blood banks, research centres and pathology labs.

sections.heading: BSc Renal Dialysis Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Renal Dialysis is an important Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, with increasing demand due to lifestyle-related diseases. Renal Dialysis Technology focuses on the procedures and techniques involved in renal dialysis treatment for patients with kidney failure. In this course, students will gain practical knowledge about hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, patient monitoring and also learn how to handle emergency during dialysis. Nowadays, due to the improper lifestyle diseases like diabetes and hypertension, the number of dialysis is increasing. After graduation, students will work in dialysis and nephrology clinics and hospitals.

sections.heading: BSc Optometry – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Optometry is a specialized Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka focused on visual health and eye care practices. In this course students will learn about eye care and visual health. Students are trained to vision test, prescription of corrective lens, eye examination and management of ocular diseases. Optometrists are work in both clinical and community places where they helps to prevent and manage the vision impairment. This course also includes practical sessions in eye hospitals and optical clinics.

sections.heading: BSC Perfusion Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Perfusion Technology stands out as a unique Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, focused on cardiac surgeries and heart-lung machines. In Perfusion technology course, students will learn about how to operate heart lung machines during major surgeries particularly cardiac surgeries. This course also covers physiology, pathology, anatomy and mechanics of extracorporeal circulation. Students will be trained to monitor the blood circulation and notice the flow of oxygen, and to manage cardiopulmonary bypass systems. After completing the three years course and internship, they will work with surgical team for critical procedures, open heart surgery and transplantation of organs.

sections.heading: BSc Radiotherapy Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

content.text: Radiotherapy is one of the specialized Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, tailored for cancer treatment using precision technology. In this course, students will learn about administering the radiation treatments for cancer patients. They will get knowledge about physics, oncology and radiation safety. Students will get hands on experience in advanced equipments like simulators, CT simulators, linear accelerators and therapy machines. This training helps them to deliver the radiation doses in precision and manage radiation related protocols. After course completion students will work in oncology departments and cancer hospitals to assist oncologists in treatments.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
What is the duration of BSc Allied Health courses in Karnataka?

content.text: The typical duration of these courses is 3 years of academic instruction followed by a compulsory internship of 6 months to 1 year, depending on the specialization and institution.

sections.heading: Do I need to appear for NEET to get admission in BSc Allied Health courses?

content.text: NEET is not required for admission into BSc Allied Health Sciences courses. Most colleges admit students based on their 10+2 marks or through direct admission.

sections.heading: What is the minimum eligibility to apply for these courses?

content.text: Students must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects. A minimum of 45% to 50% aggregate marks is usually required.

sections.heading: Are these courses recognized by the government?

content.text: Are these courses recognized by the government? Yes, most BSc Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) or other recognized universities and are approved by relevant paramedical boards.

sections.heading: Which are the most in-demand allied health specializations in Karnataka?

sections.heading: Can I get direct admission in private colleges?

content.text: Yes, many private institutions in Karnataka offer direct admission based on Class 12th marks without the need for an entrance exam.

sections.heading: What kind of job roles can I get after completing this course?

content.text: Graduates can work as cardiac technologists, medical lab technologists, OT technicians, dialysis technologists, respiratory therapists, radiographers, or optometrists in various healthcare settings

sections.heading: What is the average salary for allied health graduates in Karnataka?

content.text: Fresh graduates can expect a starting salary of INR 2.5 to 4 lakh per annum. With experience and further qualifications, salaries can go up to INR 8 lakh or more.

sections.heading: Can I pursue higher education after this course?

content.text: Yes, students can pursue M.Sc. in Allied Health Sciences, MBA in Hospital Administration, or postgraduate diploma courses for advanced career opportunities.

sections.heading: Are there job opportunities abroad for allied health graduates?

content.text: Yes, allied health professionals are in demand in countries like the UK, UAE, Canada, and Australia, provided they clear the necessary licensing or certification exams.

main_text:
Dear students, if you are looking to start your career in the field of healthcare other than MBBS, then allied health sciences is the perfect choice for you. There are different specializations of courses in Allied health sciences. These Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka cover a wide range of disciplines that help bridge the gap between diagnosis, therapy, and patient support. Allied health sciences refers to a wide group of healthcare professions that are distinct from medicine and nursing, and yet crucial to patient care and recovery. From diagnosis to therapy, from medical imaging to cardiac care technology, allied health professionals support smooth functioning of healthcare systems.

In Karnataka, a fast growing advancing state in terms of medical infrastructure and academic innovation, there are a number of reputed institutions offering BSc Allied health sciences. These courses are modified to prepare the students for employment in hospitals, diagnostic labs, and clinical places. With a strong importance for hands-on training, internships and clinical relevance, Karnataka is emerging as a top destination for students who wish to start a prominent career in allied health care. In this guide, we will explore all the Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, their top colleges, admission process and fee structure in detail.

Contents

Why Choose Karnataka for Allied Health Sciences

Karnataka is a leading center for medical and allied health sciences education in India. Karnataka’s capital Bangalore is known for its quality education and world class medical institutions and hospitals, making it a preferred choice for students to study. Other than Bangalore, cities like Mangalore, Mysore, Tumkur also have developed educational hubs and universities offering different allied health sciences courses.

In India, Karnataka is known for its modern and advanced infrastructure, quality education, modern labs and student environment. In Karnataka, a major number of institutions affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS) provides high quality education. Other than RGUHS, there are some deemed universities also there with multi speciality hospital tie-ups. Karnataka is known for its research programs, innovation and employment. Students also get opportunities to work in international healthcare.

Due to the presence of more than 150 colleges offering Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, students have access to quality education, infrastructure, and placement opportunities across major cities.

Overview of Allied health sciences courses

Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka are becoming increasingly popular due to rising demand in healthcare services and growing opportunities in both government and private sectors. Allied health sciences courses are designed to make a skilled professional to work efficiently in a healthcare environment. These programs cover diagnosis, technical, therapy and support services in healthcare. BSc Allied health sciences courses have a duration of three years of academic learning followed by a compulsory internship of six months to one year based on the course and university.

To study BSc Allied health in Karnataka, students must complete 10+2 with Physics, chemistry and biology as mandatory subjects. A minimum percentage of 45% to 50% marks is required. Some institutions may also conduct their own entrance exams or interviews for selection. Students will learn both theoretical and practical classes. Classes are conducted with advanced lab facilities even before they start their internships. These courses are recognized by Paramedical Board of Karnataka and most of the colleges are affiliated to RGUHS. After completion of allied health sciences, students are awarded a bachelor degree that qualify them to work as allied health professionals.

Courses in Allied Health Sciences

In Karnataka, there are different specializations in Allied health sciences where students can explore and choose on their respective interests.

BSc Cardiac Care Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Bsc cardiac care technology is one of the most in-demand Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka due to its high placement rate and scope in critical care. Because of its future career opportunities, students are interested in pursuing cardiac care technology. It focuses on cardiovascular medicine. These programs include subjects which are mainly focuses on echocardiography, electrocardiography, cardiac anatomy and catheterization techniques. After three years course and internship students will be able to work in ICU, assisting cardiac surgery and emergency wards.

Also Check: BSc cardiac care Technology in Bangalore BSc cardiac care Technology in Mangalore BSc cardiac care Technology in Mysore

BSc Operation Theatre Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

BSc in Operation Theatre Technology is among the key Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, ideal for students who want to work in real-time surgical settings. Students are trained to assist the surgeons during the time of operations by maintaining OT hygiene handling sterilizing equipment, surgical instruments and operation procedures. Students are also learn about infection control, anesthetics and monitor the patients. After the successful completion of course, students will work in specialty clinics, surgical units and trauma centers.

BSc Anesthesia and critical care – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Anesthesia and Critical Care is a vital Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka that prepares students for emergency and ICU environments. This course is focusing on the administration and monitoring of anesthesia during the surgery and intensive care treatments. In this course students will learn about anesthetic agents, ventilator management and patient assessment. This course is more relatable in today’s medical environment, critical care is becoming an essential part of the treatment protocols. After completing the course, students will be able to work in emergency wards, ICU, trauma care and assist with anesthesiologists in operation theatres.

BSc Respiratory Therapy – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Respiratory Therapy is one of the rapidly growing Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, especially after the COVID-19 pandemic. This courses is focusing on teaching the students about respiratory conditions like COPD, Asthma and more respiratory health issues. Respiratory courses helps students to learn about giving chest physiotherapy, managing artificial airways and handling ventilator. As respiratory conditions such as asthma, COPD, and post-COVID complications increase, the need for trained respiratory therapists is also growing. Respiratory therapy is used in ICU and emergency wards. This course also led the students to learn how to assist and manage oxygen therapy for patients with respiratory insufficiencies.

BSc Medical Imaging Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Medical Imaging is a highly in-demand Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka for students interested in diagnostic radiology. Medical Imaging Technology is focusing on teaching the use of diagnostic imaging equipment like CT scans, X rays, MRI, ultrasound machines. Students are taught to how to use these machines, positioning the patients in machines correctly, interpret results in collaboration with radiologists. The course curriculum also includes image processing techniques, radiation safety tips and anatomy. After completing the course, students will be able to work in diagnostic labs, radiology departments, even they pursue specialized training in radiodiagnosis or nuclear medicine.

BSc Medical Laboratory Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Medical Laboratory Technology is one of the core Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, essential for clinical diagnostics and pathology labs. This trains the students to do laboratory tests on biological specimens such as blood and tissues. It is a important step of disease diagnosis and monitoring. Students will learn microbiology, clinical pathology, hematology and biochemistry. After the successful completion of course, students will be work on diagnostic labs, blood banks, research centres and pathology labs.

BSc Renal Dialysis Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Renal Dialysis is an important Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, with increasing demand due to lifestyle-related diseases. Renal Dialysis Technology focuses on the procedures and techniques involved in renal dialysis treatment for patients with kidney failure. In this course, students will gain practical knowledge about hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, patient monitoring and also learn how to handle emergency during dialysis. Nowadays, due to the improper lifestyle diseases like diabetes and hypertension, the number of dialysis is increasing. After graduation, students will work in dialysis and nephrology clinics and hospitals.

BSc Optometry – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Optometry is a specialized Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka focused on visual health and eye care practices. In this course students will learn about eye care and visual health. Students are trained to vision test, prescription of corrective lens, eye examination and management of ocular diseases. Optometrists are work in both clinical and community places where they helps to prevent and manage the vision impairment. This course also includes practical sessions in eye hospitals and optical clinics.

BSC Perfusion Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Perfusion Technology stands out as a unique Allied Health Sciences course in Karnataka, focused on cardiac surgeries and heart-lung machines. In Perfusion technology course, students will learn about how to operate heart lung machines during major surgeries particularly cardiac surgeries. This course also covers physiology, pathology, anatomy and mechanics of extracorporeal circulation. Students will be trained to monitor the blood circulation and notice the flow of oxygen, and to manage cardiopulmonary bypass systems. After completing the three years course and internship, they will work with surgical team for critical procedures, open heart surgery and transplantation of organs.

BSc Radiotherapy Technology – Allied Health Sciences in Karnataka

Radiotherapy is one of the specialized Allied Health Sciences courses in Karnataka, tailored for cancer treatment using precision technology. In this course, students will learn about administering the radiation treatments for cancer patients. They will get knowledge about physics, oncology and radiation safety. Students will get hands on experience in advanced equipments like simulators, CT simulators, linear accelerators and therapy machines. This training helps them to deliver the radiation doses in precision and manage radiation related protocols. After course completion students will work in oncology departments and cancer hospitals to assist oncologists in treatments.

sections.heading: 7. How much salary can a BSc Radiotherapy graduate expect?

sections.heading: 8. Do BSc Radiotherapy colleges in Karnataka provide internships?

sections.heading: 9. Can students pursue higher studies after BSc Radiotherapy?

content.text: Ayush Counselling is the centralised counselling process for admission to courses such as Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy, directed under the Ministry of Ayush. The counselling is conducted for both UG and PG courses, and it is mandatory for the aspirants to undergo it after qualifying for the NEET examination.

This article will provide you with everything you need to know about the Ayush Counselling 2025 for UG courses, including their registration fees, important dates, cut-off, and the counseling process. Go through the entire article to learn thoroughly about what is Ayush Counselling and how to participate in the counselling to secure admission to the respective courses.
The registration for Round 1 Ayush Counselling began on August 22nd and is currently ongoing. The last date for registration is September 1, 2025.

sections.heading: Ayush Counselling Overview

content.text: Ayush Counselling for all the courses, BAMS/BSMS/BUMS/BHMS, is conducted by two authorities. Ayush Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC) is the authority conducting counselling for 15% of the All India Quota(AIQ) seats . The remaining 85% of seats are handled by the state counselling authorities . For every institution, the counselling is conducted through their respective state’s responsible authority. The Ayush Counselling process generally involves registration, choice filling, seat allotment, document verification, and reporting to the college.

According to the Ministry of Ayusha and the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM), there are 563 BAMS colleges and 57 BUMS colleges across India, Including Private, Government, aided, and deemed colleges. As per the reports of the National Commission of Homeopathy (NCH), 277 colleges in India offer the BHMS course. The BSMS course is offered by 15 colleges in the country.
For participating in the Ayush counselling for the above mentioned courses, it is mandatory to appear and qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) UG examination.
The NEET UG 2025 examination was held on May 4, 2025, and the results were out on 14th June 2025. Ayush Counselling dates are yet to be published by AACCC.

sections.heading: Ayush Counselling 2025- Detailed Process

content.text: AACCC Counselling for UG counselling involves multiple rounds of allotments for maximum seats utilization and and this allows the candidates to upgrade their choices in each round. The procedure starts with the registration and fee payment by the candidates on the official website of AACCC or the concerned state counselling authority. sections.heading: Types of Ayush Counselling

content.text: The counselling process for Ayush courses is undertaken by two different means. The All India quota seats of 15% are filled through AACCC counseling. The remaining 85% of seats are state quota, for which the concerned State/UT conducts the counselling.

sections.heading: All India Quota (AIQ) seats

content.text: 15% of the seats are under the All India Quota, and the seats are open to all candidates irrespective of their domicile. The candidates from any state and Union Territory can participate in the counselling. It is centralised, national-level counselling regulated by AACCC.

sections.heading: State Quota

content.text: The State Quota reserves 85 % of the seats for candidates who are domicile to a particular State or Union territory. The counselling process is handled by the concerned State authority of the domicile state. Different states possess their respective authorities for counselling across the country. They follow the counselling guidelines and reservation policy of the state government and the counselling conducting authority responsible. Ayush Counselling Overview

Ayush Counselling for all the courses, BAMS/BSMS/BUMS/BHMS, is conducted by two authorities. Ayush Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC) is the authority conducting counselling for 15% of the All India Quota(AIQ) seats . The remaining 85% of seats are handled by the state counselling authorities . For every institution, the counselling is conducted through their respective state’s responsible authority. The Ayush Counselling process generally involves registration, choice filling, seat allotment, document verification, and reporting to the college.

According to the Ministry of Ayusha and the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM), there are 563 BAMS colleges and 57 BUMS colleges across India, Including Private, Government, aided, and deemed colleges. As per the reports of the National Commission of Homeopathy (NCH), 277 colleges in India offer the BHMS course. The BSMS course is offered by 15 colleges in the country.

For participating in the Ayush counselling for the above mentioned courses, it is mandatory to appear and qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) UG examination.

Ayush Counselling 2025- Detailed Process

AACCC Counselling for UG counselling involves multiple rounds of allotments for maximum seats utilization and and this allows the candidates to upgrade their choices in each round. Types of Ayush Counselling

The counselling process for Ayush courses is undertaken by two different means. The All India quota seats of 15% are filled through AACCC counseling. The remaining 85% of seats are state quota, for which the concerned State/UT conducts the counselling.

All India Quota (AIQ) seats

15% of the seats are under the All India Quota, and the seats are open to all candidates irrespective of their domicile. The candidates from any state and Union Territory can participate in the counselling. It is centralised, national-level counselling regulated by AACCC.

State Quota

The State Quota reserves 85 % of the seats for candidates who are domicile to a particular State or Union territory. The counselling process is handled by the concerned State authority of the domicile state. Different states possess their respective authorities for counselling across the country. Visit the official website of NTRUHS at https://drntr.uhsap.in/ and register using your mobile number and email ID for AP Ayush registration.
Provide the necessary personal information and upload the relevant documents.
Complete the registration successfully by paying the fees as prescribed.

After successful registration with the counselling authority, the candidates can participate in the Choice Filling, where they can choose their preferences of colleges from the list of available colleges in the state.

The candidates are given a deadline to complete the choice filling and lock their choices. If the choices are not locked, their allotment cannot be processed, and they will not be allotted to any colleges.
On completion of the choice filling round, Allotment results will be published on the official website of NTRUHS.
The Seat Allotment is processed in multiple rounds. The candidates are allotted seats based on their NEET scores, preference, and after considering the reservation.
Log in with your credentials on the official website to check the allotment status.

Generally, there are 3 to 4 rounds of counselling. If allotted a college in the first round, they can move to the next steps; if not allotted during the first round, they may participate in the further rounds.
The candidates allotted seats must report to the designated centers to attend the document verification process.
Carry all the original documents and certificates, and fetch the verification slip after verifying them.
The candidates must report to the allotted college within the stipulated time with all of the necessary documents.
Complete the admission formalities and make payment of the college fees within the period provided by the college to confirm the seats.

Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling Overview

Admission to all the Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses is done through the AP Ayush counselling, which is handled by the Dr NTR University of Health Sciences . The Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling official website is https://drntr.uhsap.in/ , visit the website to find all the official information and notifications regarding the counselling. The candidates with a higher secondary science stream who studied Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects and also qualified for the NEET examination can participate in the counselling.

According to the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) , there are 2 Unani colleges, 7 BHMS colleges, 3 BNYS colleges, and 3 BAMS colleges in Andhra Pradesh . 85% of the seats are reserved for state quota under the Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling, generally offered for domicile students. And the remaining 15% are the All India quota seats, where students from other states can apply. The counselling for AIQ seats is conducted by the AACCC .

AYUSH Courses

Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling 2025 Eligibility

Here are the eligibility criteria that the candidates must meet to secure admission to various colleges under the Ministry of Ayush.

Academic Eligibility Requirements

The candidates must have passed the 10+2 examination with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in the 12th standard.

The candidates must obtain an aggregate score of 50% in the Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects of their 12th standard.

Entrance Exam

Qualifying for the NEET-UG Examination is mandatory for participating in the Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling and for securing admission to the AYUSH courses.

Age Criteria

The candidates must be of the age 17 or above before the month of December in the year of admission.

Counselling for Other State Students in AP

The students from other states are allowed to participate in the Andhra Pradesh Ayush Counselling under the All India Quota(AIQ). This quota enables the non-domiciled students to participate in the counselling for admission to government colleges that offer various Ayush courses, such as BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS. The AYUSH Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC) is the authority conducting the counselling for the AIQ seats.

For the AIQ seats counselling, the students must qualify for the NEET-UG exam and register with the official website of AACCC at https://aaccc.gov.in/ . The counselling process involves of the following steps:

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
Can I get BAMS with 250 marks in NEET?

content.text: It may be challenging to get BAMS with 250 marks in NEET in the government colleges. You will have a higher chance of admission to private colleges with your marks.

sections.heading: What is the BAMS cutoff in Karnataka for OBC?

sections.heading: What are the marks required for BAMS government college?

sections.heading: What is the BAMS NEET cutoff 2025 for the SC/ST category?

sections.heading: How many marks are required in NEET for BAMS?

content.text: The marks required in NEET for BAMS are generally from 450- 500 in government colleges and 350-450 in private colleges. The marks required in both government and private colleges are much lower for the reserved category.

sections.heading: Are management quota seats available for BAMS admission in Karnataka?

sections.heading: Can I get BAMS admission with low NEET score?

content.text: Bihar Ayush Counselling 2025 is conducted by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) for admission to Ayush courses such as BAMS, BNYS, BUMS, BSMS & BHMS. The NEET-UG examination qualification serves as the primary criterion for admission to the Ayush Courses. Private and government Ayurveda, Unani, & Homeopathy institutions in Bihar recognized by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine (NCISM) and National Commission for Homeopathy (NCH) participate in the state counselling.
The NEET-UG 2025 was held on 4 May 2025; NEET-UG results were published on 14 June 2025 . The Bihar Ayush Counselling Dates are to be announced by the authorities.
This article delves into the details of the Bihar Ayush Counselling process, including eligibility, fees, cutoff, and more.

sections.heading: Bihar Ayush Counselling Overview

content.text: Bihar Ayush Counselling is conducted for admission to BAMS, BUMS & BHMS courses by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) . The candidates should register themselves with the Bihar Ayush Counselling official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/ for participating in the counselling. The NEET-UG examination conducted by NTA is the mandatory qualification required for applying to the UGMAC (Ayush). In order to participate in the counselling, NEET-qualified candidates must possess higher secondary education in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects.

Bihar has 10 BAMS colleges , 15 BHMS colleges, and 5 BUMS colleges participating in the state counselling. The state counseling reserves 85% of seats for the domicile students of Bihar under the state quota. The students from other states/non-domicile students can apply to Ayush colleges in Bihar only through the 15% of seats under the All India Quota, which is managed by the AACCC .

sections.heading: Bihar Ayush Counselling Fees

content.text: Candidates must pay the Counselling fees at the time of registration. The registration fee is not refundable. Refer to the table below for the Bihar Ayush Counselling fees according to the category of the candidates.

sections.heading: Bihar Ayush Counselling Eligibility

content.text: The following are the requirements to be eligible to participate in the Bihar Ayush Counselling 2025.
Entrance Examination

items: All the candidates must be NEET-UG 2025 qualified to participate in the counselling.

content.text: Academic Qualification

items: Candidates must have 10+2 in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects and should have passed in the English subject.
Candidates belonging to the unreserved category must obtain an aggregate of 50% in the PCB subjects taken together in their 12th standard.
Candidates belonging to the reserved category shall obtain 40% aggregate in the PCB subjects taken together in their 12th standard.

content.text: Age Limit

items: In the year of admission, the candidate must be at least 17 years of age.

content.text: Domicile Requirement

items: Candidates must possess a valid domicile of Bihar to participate in the counselling under the state quota.

Bihar Ayush Counselling Overview

Bihar Ayush Counselling is conducted for admission to BAMS, BUMS & BHMS courses by the Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) . The candidates should register themselves with the Bihar Ayush Counselling official website at https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/ for participating in the counselling. The NEET-UG examination conducted by NTA is the mandatory qualification required for applying to the UGMAC (Ayush). In order to participate in the counselling, NEET-qualified candidates must possess higher secondary education in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects.

Bihar has 10 BAMS colleges , 15 BHMS colleges, and 5 BUMS colleges participating in the state counselling. The state counseling reserves 85% of seats for the domicile students of Bihar under the state quota. The students from other states/non-domicile students can apply to Ayush colleges in Bihar only through the 15% of seats under the All India Quota, which is managed by the AACCC .

Academic Qualification

Candidates must have 10+2 in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects and should have passed in the English subject.

Candidates belonging to the unreserved category must obtain an aggregate of 50% in the PCB subjects taken together in their 12th standard.

Candidates belonging to the reserved category shall obtain 40% aggregate in the PCB subjects taken together in their 12th standard.

Age Limit

Seats are allotted on the basis of NEET-UG scores, merit rank, reservation policy, and choice of colleges.

Candidates shall log in to the official website of BCECEB, UGMAC (Ayush) to view the result and download the allotment letter.

Document Verification

After seats are allotted, candidates have to report to the designated center for document verification. The original certificates and documents should be produced for verification.

Reporting to Allotted College

The candidates must join the college allotted to them and submit the original documents to the college. Make payment of the prescribed college fees to confirm your admission.

Vacant seats after the allotment of previous rounds are only filled through the stray vacancy round.

Registration and online choice filling shall be done once, which applies to both Round 1 & Round 2.

Seats are allotted based on the NEET score, merit rank, reservation of seats, and the choice of colleges in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Round 3/ Stray Vacancy Round.

The eligibility and participation criteria for each round vary.

Stray Vacancy round allotment is made for vacant seats after the previous rounds.

Allotment Result Publication

The Allotment result is published on the official website of AACCC. Log in to the website with your credentials and download the allotment letter.

Physical Reporting to College

Candidates must report to the allotted college with the necessary original certificates for verification and make payment of the fees within the time prescribed by the college to confirm your seat.

Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling Overview

Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh handles the Ayush Counselling in Chhattisgarh for all the Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy courses. To participate in the counselling, the candidates have to register with the Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling official website at https://cgayush.admissions.nic.in/ . Students with higher secondary education in the science stream with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects, along with NEET-UG qualification of that current year, are eligible to participate in the counselling.

The admissions are offered under the State quota, with 85% seats reserved only for the domicile students of Chhattisgarh, and the All India Quota (AIQ), with 15% of seats open to all, including non-domicile or students from other states. All India Quota seats counselling is conducted by the Ayush Admissions Central Counseling Committee ( AACC C) .

There are 7 BAMS colleges , 3 BHMS colleges, 1 BUMS college, and 1 BNYS college in Chhattisgarh. Currently, there are no BSMS colleges in the state.

Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling Process- State Quota

Here is the procedure involved in the Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling under the State Quota.

Online Application

Register online through the website of the Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh, https://cgayush.admissions.nic.in/.

Submit the application by providing relevant personal and academic information and uploading necessary documents.

Make the registration fee payment to complete the online application.

Candidates can choose State Quota or AIQ, or both, during registration.

Round 1

Choice Filling/Locking: Candidates must fill in the choice of colleges in order of their preference. It is mandatory to lock the choices before proceeding to further processing.

Seat Allotment: Seats are allotted based on the NEET scores, reservation policy, and the choice of colleges.

Allotment Result: The allotment results are published on the official website. Candidates should download the Allotment Letter for the further admission process.

Document Verification: Candidates must attend the verification by the Scrutiny Committee at the designated centers.

Reporting to Allotted College: Candidates must report to the allotted college to complete the admission process with the original documents and make payment of the prescribed college fees.

Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling Process- All India Quota (AIQ)

Here is the procedure involved in the Chhattisgarh Ayush Counselling under the All India Quota, conducted by the AACCC .

Registration and Fee Payment

Candidates must register with the official website of AACCC at www.aaccc.gov.in to participate in the counselling.

Submit the application with relevant personal/academic details and upload the necessary documents.

Make payment of the counselling fees to complete the registration.

Choice Filling/ Locking

Candidates must fill in the choices of colleges and the state according to their preference.

It is mandatory to lock the choice before the deadline.

Seat Allotment

Seats are allotted in multiple rounds: Round 1/ Round 2/ Mop-up Round/ Stray Vacancy Round.

Allotments are made according to the NEET scores, merit rank, reservation policy, and the choices of the college.

The rule of participation and eligibility in each round varies.

Publication of Allotment List

The Allotment List is published in the official website of AACCC. Log in with the credentials and download the Allotment Letter.

Physical Reporting to Allotted College

The candidates must report to the allotted college with the necessary original certificates for verification and make payment of the fees within the stipulated time.

sections.heading: Important Points to Note

items: All the listed documents required for ayush counselling are to be submitted to the college while reporting for admission. The original copy of the certificates and documents is only accepted by the institutions. Photocopies must be avoided.

It is necessary to produce the original certificates during document verification at the help centers. Wrong information entered on the application or different documents may result in the cancellation of admission.
The original certificates can be retained if submitted to any college during allotment, and the seats are cancelled or upgraded.

In some cases, the state counselling authority may instruct the candidates to upload the relevant documents during the registration process. In AACCC counselling, generally, documents need not be uploaded to the website; however, the relevant information is to be entered in the portal.
